warning.standby: Inverter in standby or unreachable (normal at night)
warning.unreachable: Inverter unreachable while it was producing: check the logger Wi-Fi (see the app diagnostic log)

errors.unreachable: Logger unreachable. Is the inverter producing right now? Details:
errors.forecast_disabled: The production forecast is off: enable it in the device settings (Production forecast).
errors.forecast_unavailable: No production forecast available for that day yet (weather forecast not downloaded).
errors.forecast_window: Invalid time range: the end must be after the start (00:00 as the end means midnight).

pair.subtitle: Local connection to the inverter's Solarman Wi-Fi logger (TCP port 8899). Add the device during daytime, while the inverter is producing.
pair.host_hint: Find it in your router's list of connected devices. A fixed (static DHCP) address is recommended.
pair.sn_hint: 10-digit 'Device serial number' on the logger's label or web page (not the inverter serial number).

cause.unreachable: logger unreachable on the network (Wi-Fi drop, logger switched off or IP address changed)
cause.port_closed: logger reachable but port 8899 refused (logger restarting or firmware change)
cause.no_response: connected to the logger but no answer in time (logger busy, or weak Wi-Fi)
cause.closed: connection closed by the logger during the read (unstable Wi-Fi or logger busy with the cloud)
cause.inverter_silent: logger busy or inverter not answering on the logger–inverter link (collision with the TSUN cloud polling, or inverter stopped)
cause.corrupt: corrupted answer on the logger–inverter link (collision with the TSUN cloud polling)
cause.serial: wrong logger serial number in the device settings

settings.title: TSUN Micro-inverters – Diagnostics
settings.intro: Diagnostic log of the TSUN inverters: communication (Wi-Fi), panels, grid and inverter. Copy it to analyse a malfunction or to report a problem.
settings.notify_alarm: Inverter alarm, fault or high temperature
settings.copy_manual: Select the text below and copy it
settings.export_intro: Full report: versions, settings (serial numbers masked), state of each inverter, current values, today's statistics and the whole diagnostic log.
settings.show_report: Show the report to copy it
settings.bl_intro: Usual production of each panel compared with the best panel at the same moment, by hour (100 % = full sun, low values = recurring shadow), learned in direct sun. Alerts come from the evening verdict: each panel must reach its usual best share at least once during the day. A shadow only lowers a panel for part of the day and is never reported; a defect lowers it all day. The threshold widens by itself for a naturally irregular panel, and a drop confirmed on 7 sunny days becomes the new normal.
settings.bl_mode_simple: Simple detection (profile learned but not used)
settings.bl_confirm: Reset the learned profile of this inverter? Use it after a change (pruned tree, cleaned or replaced panel). Underperformance alerts resume once the time slots have been learned again (3 sunny days).
settings.bl_empty: Nothing learned yet: the profile builds up while the panels produce.
settings.bl_best: Best share of the day (evening verdict)
